newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso slips in speculative session.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso slips in speculative session.

text.p: Colombia's peso slipped back 3.5 pesos to 1,061.9 to the dollar against the backdrop of what interbank traders termed "artifical (dollar) demand".
The fall, which traders said took place less than half an hour before the close of trade, came after a week of strong rises.
"Today was more a day of speculation than anything else because there was no real demand for greenbacks," one trader said. "But there's still a lot of dollars flowing into the market," he added.
Few traders were convinced recent efforts by the central bank to lower repo rates and overnight deposit rates would push down the peso.
"We believe the peso could climb to 1,050 to the dollar and stabilize at that point," another trader said.
Dealers reported 521 trades worth a total $223 million, above the daily average of about $180 million. The peso opened at 1,054.5 and hit an intraday high of 1,052.2.
